missionaries.name: John & Karen Whitfield
missionaries.prayer: Pray for endurance as the New Testament translation enters its final review stage.

letters.title: Final Review Underway
letters.excerpt: The translation committee met for two weeks to review the Gospel of John. Pray for clarity as we finish the remaining books this year.

letters.title: A Season of Testing
letters.excerpt: Health challenges slowed our pace this quarter, but the team pressed on. Thank you for standing with us in prayer.

missionaries.name: David & Anna Torres
missionaries.prayer: Pray for the children's home expansion and for laborers to join the discipleship team.

letters.title: Ground Broken
letters.excerpt: Construction on the second dormitory began this month. We rejoice to see the Lord provide through so many faithful churches.

letters.title: Five New Believers
letters.excerpt: Five young men from the discipleship program professed faith this quarter. Pray for their growth and baptism.

missionaries.prayer: Pray for open doors among unreached families and wisdom for a team laboring quietly in a sensitive region.

letters.title: Steady Progress
letters.excerpt: A small gathering continues to meet. Details are kept general for the team's protection — please pray for continued favor and safety.
